clips.title: The story
paras: Stonewatch Falls is a scenic waterfall and deep mountain pool situated in the eastern reaches of the Redridge Mountains, fed by the outflow of Lake Everstill. Cascading down the hillside beneath the looming heights of Stonewatch, its isolated waters are claimed by a hostile tribe of murlocs.

Pouring from the eastern river of Lake Everstill, Stonewatch Falls cascades down the rugged terrain beneath the Blackrock orc stronghold of Stonewatch. The plunging water carves out a deep pool tucked against the mountainside. Despite its natural beauty, travelers rarely linger to admire the view; a vicious band of murlocs infests the pool, building crude reed hovels and preying upon any foolish enough to trespass along the water's edge.
